findings.evidence: Morrey.lean private theorem: the block after `-- The section read off from the representative of a chosen chart at each point.` uses only atlas/trivialization API, no Sobolev or measure facts.
findings.fix: State that gluing lemma in `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean` (hypotheses: `ContinuousOn (g i) (A.image i)` and the `hcompat` EqOn), and reduce the private theorem to proving `hcompat` and applying it.
findings.issue: `exists_continuous_eqOn_preciseRepresentative` is ~80 lines; its second half (`idx`/`t`/`hcoord`/`heq`/`hcont`) proves a Sobolev-independent fact: chart-wise maps `g i`, continuous on `A.image i` and satisfying the cocycle relation on `A.overlap i i'`, glue to a continuous section with `A.coord i t = g i` on `A.image i`.

findings.evidence: grep `continuousOn_symm` in FiniteBundleAtlas finds only the inline use at Basic.lean:198; Morrey.lean `hchart` repeats it.
findings.fix: Add `theorem continuousOn_chart_symm (i) : ContinuousOn (A.chart i).symm (A.image i)` to Basic.lean, use it in `continuousOn_coord`, and obtain `hchart` as `(A.continuousOn_chart_symm i').mono (A.overlap_subset_image i i')`.
findings.issue: Continuity of `(A.chart i).symm` on chart images is proved inline here (`hsymm`) and again in Morrey.lean (`hchart`, on `A.overlap i i'`) with the same `continuousOn_symm.mono` + `mem_image`/`mem_overlap` + `map_source` argument.

summary: Proofs are robust and mostly readable, but the ~80-line private gluing proof embeds a general atlas-level gluing lemma that should be factored out, and continuity of the inverse chart on chart images is re-proved inline twice.
